description: This file defines the WebApplication class, which extends SNApplication and implements WebApplicationInterface. It manages web and mobile application behaviors, including event handling, service initialization, and platform-specific features within a web-based environment.

classes.name: WebApplication
classes.description: Main class managing web and mobile application lifecycle, services, and platform-specific behaviors within the project.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up resources and deinitializes services when the application is shutting down.

methods.name: addWebEventObserver
methods.description: Registers a new observer for web events and returns a function to remove it.

methods.name: notifyWebEvent
methods.description: Notifies all registered observers of a specific web event.

methods.name: publishPanelDidResizeEvent
methods.description: Publishes a panel resize event with specified parameters.

methods.name: getViewControllerManager
methods.description: Returns the view controller manager instance.

methods.name: getDesktopService
methods.description: Returns the desktop service if available.

methods.name: getAutolockService
methods.description: Returns the autolock service.

methods.name: getArchiveService
methods.description: Returns the archive service.

methods.name: paneController
methods.description: Accessor for the pane controller.

methods.name: linkingController
methods.description: Accessor for the linking controller.

methods.name: changelogService
methods.description: Accessor for the changelog service.

methods.name: momentsService
methods.description: Accessor for the moments service.

methods.name: featuresController
methods.description: Accessor for the features controller.

methods.name: desktopDevice
methods.description: Returns the desktop device interface if applicable.

methods.name: isNativeIOS
methods.description: Checks if the platform is native iOS.

methods.name: isMobileDevice
methods.description: Determines if the current device is a mobile device.

methods.name: hideOutboundSubscriptionLinks
methods.description: Indicates whether outbound subscription links should be hidden (iOS only).

methods.name: mobileDevice
methods.description: Returns the mobile device interface, throws error if not on a mobile platform.

methods.name: getThemeService
methods.description: Returns the theme service.

methods.name: keyboardService
methods.description: Returns the keyboard service.

methods.name: checkForSecurityUpdate

methods.name: downloadBackup
methods.description: Initiates backup download if on desktop.

methods.name: signOutAndDeleteLocalBackups
methods.description: Signs out user and deletes local backups if on desktop.

methods.name: isGlobalSpellcheckEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether global spellcheck is enabled.

methods.name: getItemTags
methods.description: Retrieves tags referencing a specific item.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the application version.

methods.name: toggleGlobalSpellcheck
methods.description: Toggles the global spellcheck setting.

methods.name: handleMobileEnteringBackgroundEvent
methods.description: Handles app backgrounding on mobile.

methods.name: handleMobileGainingFocusEvent
methods.description: Handles app gaining focus on mobile.

methods.name: handleInitialMobileScreenshotPrivacy
methods.description: Sets initial screenshot privacy on Android.

methods.name: handleMobileLosingFocusEvent
methods.description: Handles app losing focus on mobile.

methods.name: handleMobileResumingFromBackgroundEvent
methods.description: Handles app resuming from background on mobile.

methods.name: handleMobileColorSchemeChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles mobile color scheme changes.

methods.name: handleMobileKeyboardWillChangeFrameEvent
methods.description: Handles keyboard frame changes before they occur.

methods.name: handleMobileKeyboardDidChangeFrameEvent
methods.description: Handles keyboard frame changes after they occur.

methods.name: handleAndroidU2FAuthenticatorResponse
methods.description: Processes U2F authenticator responses.

methods.name: handleAndroidBackButtonPressed
methods.description: Handles Android back button presses.

methods.name: addAndroidBackHandlerEventListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for Android back button events.

methods.name: setAndroidBackHandlerFallbackListener
methods.description: Sets fallback listener for Android back button.

methods.name: isAuthorizedToRenderItem
methods.description: Checks if the user is authorized to view an item.

methods.description: Checks if user is entitled to per-tag preferences.
